sources.title: TheBloke/Luna-AI-Llama2-Uncensored-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repo contains GGUF format model files for Tap-M's Luna AI Llama2 Uncensored. Many thanks to William Beauchamp from Chai for providing the hardware used to make and upload these files! About GGUF GGUF is a new format introduced by the llama.cpp team on August 21st 2023. It is a replacement for GGML, which is no longer supported by llama.cpp.
